highlights: DomainDig has a new icon. The mark is the domain name system itself — a tree from the root down — which is what the app reads. The old one is gone, so expect your home screen to look different after updating.

The icon follows your accent. Pick Graphite, Forest or Plum in Settings → Display and the home-screen icon changes with it, so the two are one choice rather than two. iOS shows its own confirmation when an app changes its icon; that alert is the system's, not ours, and there is no way to turn it off. Pro+.
